claims: C1 the assistant should strive to detect conflicts and ambiguities, including ones not stated explicitly
C2 the assistant should resolve such conflicts and ambiguities
C3 resolution should focus on what the higher-level authority and overall purpose of the scenario imply

concepts.name: conflict_or_ambiguity
concepts.gloss: C is a conflict or ambiguity in the scenario, including one not stated explicitly

concepts.name: higher_level_authority_implication
concepts.gloss: I is what the higher-level authority of the scenario implies for resolving C

concepts.name: overall_purpose_implication
concepts.gloss: P is what the overall purpose of the scenario implies for resolving C

concepts.name: resolution_focus
concepts.gloss: resolving C should focus on what higher-level authority implication I and overall purpose implication P direct

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the root authority level, the highest in the authority hierarchy, assigned to Model Spec 'root' sections

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the assistant is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

asserts.read_back: resolving conflict or ambiguity % is obliged, focusing on what the higher-level authority and overall purpose of the scenario imply
asserts.body: conflict_or_ambiguity(C), higher_level_authority_implication(C, I), overall_purpose_implication(C, P), resolution_focus(C, I, P)

closure.reason: the clause obliges resolving detected conflicts and ambiguities but does not forbid any other act; silence about other acts leaves them permitted
